name: Headset
author: Ganesh Gunasegaran <me@itsgg.com>
description: Bluetooth headset controls in the bar: noise cancelling, equaliser, battery and behaviour, read from the device itself.

barWidget.description: Noise control, equaliser, battery and settings for a connected Bluetooth headset. Sony WH-1000XM5 and relatives.

schema.label: Control session
schema.description: A headset allows one control session at a time. Hold keeps it, so the bar always shows live settings. On-demand releases it shortly after the panel closes, so a phone can take it back.

schema.label: Release the session after (seconds)
schema.description: Only used when the control session is set to on-demand.
